steps.source_code:
# Task 13: Your code here
import time

prompt13 = "A civic building with stone facade, generous stairs, public square, morning light, neoclassical-modern hybrid style, architectural photography"
steps_list = [10, 25, 50, 75]
images = []
titles = []

for steps in steps_list:
    generator = torch.Generator("cuda").manual_seed(321)
    start = time.time()
    img = pipe(
        prompt13,
        num_inference_steps=steps,
        guidance_scale=7.5,
        generator=generator
    ).images[0]
    end = time.time()

    images.append(img)
    titles.append(f"{steps} steps\n{end - start:.1f}s")

show_images(images, titles=titles, figsize=(20, 5))
